head: bcaf7a2538a10176c89dd1fddddafbe29826b56e
scope: Full screen/fan+lighting group storage snapshots and shared-journal atomic restore foundation; no group archive transport/runtime workflow yet

source_findings: Windows exports ZIP backup metadata plus serialized complete controller profile; imports selected group rather than one named slot.
Screen import owns active config/brightness/rotation, eight slots and three galleries; WMSQ export includes all uploaded files.
FanAndLighting import owns Fan/Pump settings, topology/sync, selected modes and all RGB mode profiles; applies four requests and attempts rollback on save failure.
Controller import matches TypeID in this loop, not device Metadata path. Linux target must be explicit.

contract.content: Version1 typed Screen/FanAndLighting snapshots; exact slot indices and sensor IDs; active/cached scene, collections, inactive manual/dynamic mode registry. No source identity or receipts.
contract.concurrency: Target-side SHA256 snapshot and profile-library revision; direct latest-owner snapshot simulates queued deltas. No production SettingsUpdate/IPC caller connected yet.
contract.restore: Replaces only selected group and its slots; preserves other group/global thermal; target collection revision increments; screen reset receipt cleared; shared two-file journal handles recovery.
contract.assets: Primitive does not copy or prepare assets; future caller must validate/stage/pin them before publication. Legacy gallery materialization required before replacing versioned collections.
contract.recovery: No durable group-import ID receipt yet. Post-journal errors require recovery/readback; stale target token cannot blindly repeat import.

coverage: Screen roundtrip into another store replaces sparse slots and retains cooling/lighting/global thermal; restart reads exact state.
FanAndLighting roundtrip includes both slot groups, inactive Meteor mode, dynamic source/unit registry and exact sensor bindings; screen remains intact.
Queued same-group changes and global library changes reject stale tokens; queued neighbor changes survive.
Unknown version/fields, foreign/duplicate slots, unsafe LCD modes, invalid cooling, corrupt target reject without partial publication.
Legacy collections require materialization before replacing versioned catalog; Screen restore clears old reset receipt.

journal_fault_test.name: profile_group_import_recovers_whole_group_at_each_journal_boundary
journal_fault_test.coverage: Both groups at journal/device/profiles publication failures; fresh store recovers exact settings+library and preserves neighboring group.

checks.gui_native: NOT RUN: frontend untouched, group RPC/GUI not implemented
checks.hardware: NOT RUN: user deferred; file-backed storage only

remaining: Group archive codec and active/cached/slot/gallery/legacy payloads with typed remap and pins
Owner message integration, durable group import receipt/readback, runtime preparation and reconciliation
Group Unix IPC/CLI/native GUI and browser/native fault/accessibility acceptance
Windows ZIP decoding/profile mapping and interoperability
Hardware acceptance deferred; additional LCD effects/Style Express remain last
